dek: An unusual split seems to have become visible in the KMT, with Legislative Yuan president Han Kuo-yu lashing out at KMT legislative caucus leader Fu Kun-chi earlier this month. Specifically, Han criticized Fu for failing to appear at cross-party negotiations over the budget
